notes.title: 13th Month Update & more!!!
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW UPDATE[/h1]

Called "13th Month Update", it adds, for free, a new month with awesome new designs from Ringsel ([url=https://twitter.com/Ringsel1]Twitter[/url] - [url=https://www.patreon.com/ringsel]Patreon[/url]), the digital artist who created all the other drawings of the game!

Ringsel is even more in troubles with this new update including a lot of naughty teasing, sexy hosiery and an old but very lewd draft (one of my favorite) as a fifth puzzle!

The game will not have new achievement with this update because we believe that people who completed the game 100% should keep it so it's only extra!

notes.title: Update v1.16
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
Small update to fix/improve the game with some feedback I received:
- The 60 puzzles completed achievement now works if you purchase the last puzzle (instead of completing it)
- Changed the buttons on the top left corner in puzzle so they take less space.
- Added a tooltip on the horizontal scrollbar in win screen to explain what is the scrollbar about (switch between images).
- "Ocotober" typos fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
I received a lot of feedback and suggestions for improvements since the release Wednesday mainly from the awesome Linux subreddit #linux_gaming and Ringsel discord! Thank you guys!

Here is the second "mini-update":
- Fix "When pressing ESC in Options, the game froze" bug
- Fix wrong translations on Options, in game.
- Fix "Go to Gallery" button on the main menu.
- Fix "Discord" button in Credits.

- Reduced the fade in/fade out in the Gallery to go from one picture to another.
- Add an invisible button to exit the slideshow (for people using tactile screens like Chromebook)
- The "Mode Tips" at the bottom left, during a puzzle, is now only displayed during January/February. If not only the "?" is visible.
- You can now scroll in/out on picture in the Gallery to look the awesome Ringsel pictures perfectly (for people using very wide screens).

If you are interested to join the early stages of our lewd game productions we created a [url=https://discord.gg/2Y7Cb4M]Discord: Join us[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I received a lot of good feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/NSFW18Games/]Steam[/url]/[url=https://twitter.com/Nsfw18G]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://discord.gg/2Y7Cb4M]Discord[/url] and addressed most of them in this small update (1.1):

- MAJOR: the game was using a lot the CG of the computer during puzzles to increase the FPS. Fixed.
- Bug: when the player started a puzzle and left, the picture was not completed but unlocked in the gallery. Fixed.
- Bug: when the player completed the 4th picture in December, the game displayed "1002 pictures unlocked". Fixed.
- Bug: in some cases at the end of the game even if you unlocked multiple pictures, the game displayed "1 picture unlocked". Fixed.
- Bug: the first variation of the first picture wasn't visible in the Gallery. Fixed.
